method.steady: begin_frame + end_frame; pre-existing static instances; no per-object API calls
method.switch_all: begin_frame + render_capsule for every instance + end_frame; alternating cached 32 and low resolution
method.wall_ms: perf_counter_ns through glFinish after each frame; includes host work and completed GL work
method.gl_ms: GPU timeline across frame commands; may include idle time waiting for host submission; not draw-only or CUDA kernel time
method.excluded: renderer/mesh creation, initial instance upload, warmup, pixel reads, telemetry and query-result retrieval
method.order: seeded random case order separately in each repeat; both resolutions warmed before switch timing
method.limits: shared GPU, no clock locking; latency reciprocal is not application or display FPS; lower LOD changes fidelity
